en.t: As he recited the poem, he kept raising his hand to wipe away his tears.

units.source_text: 明石道人听了这诗，更加颓丧，几乎不省人事。

en.t: When the Akashi monk heard this poem, he became even more despondent and nearly lost consciousness.

units.source_text: 自从源氏公子去后，他竟变得起居困难，行步蹒跚了。

en.t: Ever since Prince Genji had gone away, he had grown so weak that even rising, sitting, and walking had become difficult, and his steps were unsteady.
